name: DevOps Engineer
description: Builds and operates the pipelines, infrastructure and observability that ship software reliably.
overview: DevOps engineers are the people who make software reach users quickly and safely. You connect developers and operations: you automate builds and releases, run applications in the cloud, and make sure that when something breaks, the team finds out fast and fixes it.
day_to_day: Build automated pipelines that test and deploy code on every change
Package applications in containers and run them on cloud infrastructure
Watch dashboards and alerts, and trace why a service slowed down or failed

name: MEAN Stack Developer
description: Builds full-stack web applications with MongoDB, Express, Angular and Node.js.
overview: MEAN stack developers build complete web applications on their own, from the screen a user clicks to the database behind it. You use one language, JavaScript, across MongoDB, Express, Angular and Node.js, which makes it a quick way to ship real products.
day_to_day: Build interactive pages and forms with Angular
Write the server routes and APIs that power them with Node.js and Express
Design and query the MongoDB data the application stores

name: Java Backend Developer
description: Builds backend services and APIs using Java, Spring and relational databases.
overview: Java backend developers build the engines behind apps: the services, APIs and databases that handle payments, orders and accounts. Banks, e-commerce and large enterprises rely on Java because it is dependable at scale, so this is a steady, in-demand path.
day_to_day: Write REST APIs and business logic with Java and Spring Boot
Design relational database tables and write efficient SQL
Test, debug and improve the performance of services that many users depend on

name: AI Developer
description: Builds machine learning models and GenAI applications, from data to deployment.
overview: AI developers build software that learns from data or uses large language models. You prepare data, train and evaluate models, and then turn them into working features such as recommendations, chatbots and predictions that people can actually use.
day_to_day: Clean and explore data, then train and evaluate machine learning models
Build apps on top of language models, including prompts and retrieval of documents
Deploy models behind APIs and monitor whether they keep working well
growth_path: AI Architect or Research and Product Lead
